system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

  {
    "pattern": "Document destruction post-election timing insinuation",
    "detail": "Highlighting document destruction following electoral defeats with temporal proximity suggesting evidence concealment without direct allegation.",
    "debias": "Report document destruction allegations with specific evidence and avoid implying guilt through timing alone.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "He faces accusations of sharing classified information with Russia and destroying sensitive documents.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/16/where-is-szijjarto-hungarian-minister-to-skip-eu-meeting-after-vanishing-from-public-view",
    "unbiased_text": "Szijjártó faces allegations of sharing classified information with Russia and destroying documents, according to opposition claims that have not been independently verified."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Currency performance nationalist vindication",
    "detail": "Framing strong currency performance of politically controversial states as validation or ironic success amid international criticism.",
    "debias": "Report currency movements with economic fundamentals rather than political narrative framing.",

    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Top 10 currencies in 2026 include Hungarian forint: Why they're beating the US dollar",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/business/2026/04/16/top-10-currencies-in-2026-include-hungarian-forint-why-theyre-beating-the-us-dollar",
    "unbiased_text": "The Hungarian forint is among currencies appreciating against the US dollar in 2026, driven by interest rate differentials and regional economic factors."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Strategic resource depletion countdown",

    "debias": "Report resource supply constraints with current status rather than countdown-to-depletion framing.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Europe has six weeks of jet fuel left caused by 'dire strait' crisis, IEA chief warns",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/16/europe-has-six-weeks-of-jet-fuel-left-caused-by-dire-strait-crisis-iea-chief-warns",
    "unbiased_text": "Europe's jet fuel supplies are being affected by reduced tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, IEA chief says"
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Missing official accountability speculation",
    "detail": "Using official's public absence to insinuate avoidance of accountability through conspiratorial framing.",
    "debias": "Report official absences from scheduled events factually without speculating about motives or wrongdoing.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Where is Szijjártó? Hungarian minister to skip EU meeting after vanishing from public view",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/16/where-is-szijjarto-hungarian-minister-to-skip-eu-meeting-after-vanishing-from-public-view",
    "unbiased_text": "Hungarian Foreign Minister Szijjártó will not attend next week's EU Foreign Affairs Council meeting"
  }
]
